limitations: No hardware minimum, runtime or monetary cost is stated in these README sections; no cost estimate is inferred.
Checkpoint downloads, dataset bytes and transitive dependencies are not checksum-pinned by this guide. Pinning the repository does not pin those external resources.
Changing the data, embedder or Hydra settings changes the evaluation configuration; this example does not establish reproduction of a published score.
Not executed. The commands were checked against the code at 58ad410 and the download URLs by HTTP HEAD on 19 Nov 2026.
prerequisites: Git and a conda environment with Python 3.10; the README recommends this Python version.
curl and wget on PATH. bend.utils.download.download_model calls wget.
About 3.6 GB of disk for the gene-finding inputs and the two checkpoints, plus space for the embedding shards.
Internet access to the BEND data share aNQa0Oz2lY on sid.erda.dk. Keep the data/ and pretrained_models/ folder names shown in the steps; conf/embedding/embed.yaml expects them.

steps.explanation: The clone command comes from the README; the detached checkout selects commit 58ad410 (merge of frederikkemarin/BEND#79, 18 Nov 2026), which fixed the checkpoint links and the missing requirements.
steps.shell:
git clone https://github.com/frederikkemarin/BEND.git
cd BEND
git checkout --detach 58ad41011125cfca339d511e9b8eb536a54b582a
steps.source_locator: README.md lines 36 to 43, unchanged at 58ad410; pinned repository revision
steps.title: Check out the reviewed code

steps.explanation: At 58ad410 requirements.txt includes lxml, h5py and pysam, so no extra install is needed. At the previous pin, ac6e80c, they were missing (frederikkemarin/BEND#53).
steps.shell:
conda create -n bend python=3.10
conda activate bend
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -e .
steps.title: Install the environment

steps.explanation: Replaces python scripts/download_bend.py, which fetches the whole share (about 7.25 GB). Gene finding reads only the GRCh38 FASTA (with its index) and the gene_finding BED and HDF5 files, about 3.51 GB in total. The share id is the one scripts/download_bend.py uses at 58ad410.
steps.shell:
S=https://sid.erda.dk/share_redirect/aNQa0Oz2lY
mkdir -p data/genomes data/gene_finding
for f in GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.fai; do
  curl -fL -o "data/genomes/$f" "$S/data/genomes/$f"
done
for f in gene_finding.bed gene_finding.hdf5; do
  curl -fL -o "data/gene_finding/$f" "$S/data/gene_finding/$f"
done
steps.source_locator: README.md line 48 at 58ad410; conf/embedding/embed.yaml gene_finding entry and scripts/download_bend.py SHARE_ID at 58ad410; file sizes from HTTP HEAD on 19 Nov 2026
steps.title: Download only the gene-finding inputs

steps.explanation: download_model writes the five checkpoint files straight into destination_dir, so each model needs its own folder; the default ./pretrained_models/ would mix the two. The folder names match model_path in conf/embedding/embed.yaml at 58ad410 (convnet for the resnetlm embedder, awd_lstm for awdlstm). The embedders also call download_model when the folder is missing; downloading first makes a failure show here rather than during embedding.
steps.shell: python -c "from bend.utils.download import download_model; download_model('convnet', destination_dir='pretrained_models/convnet'); download_model('awd_lstm', destination_dir='pretrained_models/awd_lstm')"
steps.source_locator: bend/utils/download.py download_model and conf/embedding/embed.yaml resnetlm and awdlstm entries at 58ad410

steps.explanation: The README example with task restricted to gene_finding, since only those inputs were downloaded. The Hydra keys are still resnetlm and awdlstm at 58ad410; only their model_path changed. Embeddings are stored as Webdataset tar.gz shards.

summary: Run the official gene-finding downstream example using the BEND ResNetLM (dilated ResNet) and AWD-LSTM embeddings. This is one BEND task, not the entire suite. Only the gene-finding inputs are downloaded.
